task_spec: Add rank(items): order by score descending. Ties (equal score) MUST be broken by ascending id (lowest id first) so the ordering is deterministic across shards.

bugs.description: rank sorts only by -score, so ties fall back to input order (Python's stable sort), not the required ascending-id tie-break. Correct key: (-it['score'], it['id']). Sorting by score alone looks correct; only the arbitrary tie-break rule (spec only) reveals the bug.

provenance.note: arbitrary rule lives ONLY in task_spec; not derivable from code or world knowledge
